subject.title: [Bug]: Coding Agent never completes anything (worked in 2026.4.2 and earlier)

question: Should the disabled-heartbeat exec-event fix preserve explicit `heartbeat.target: "none"` suppression and add retry ownership before merge, or may exec completions override that operator opt-out?
rationale: The remaining implementation choice affects message delivery and possible command-output exposure, so the linked PR cannot be treated as a routine mechanical fix until maintainers choose the delivery contract.

options.title: Preserve opt-out and repair the fix
options.body: Refresh or replace the linked PR so exec-event wakes run with `heartbeat.every=0m` but `target: "none"` remains a hard delivery opt-out and deferred fallback wakes have a retry owner.

options.title: Accept delivery override explicitly
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally let origin-carrying exec completions override `target: "none"`, but that needs compatibility and security sign-off plus live proof.

options.title: Close the candidate and rescope
options.body: If the current linked branch is too stale or risky, close it and keep this issue open for a new scoped implementation.

recommendation.title: Preserve opt-out and repair the fix
recommendation.body: Refresh or replace the linked PR so exec-event wakes run with `heartbeat.every=0m` but `target: "none"` remains a hard delivery opt-out and deferred fallback wakes have a retry owner.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a delivery/security product contract decision, and Peter is both the listed project maintainer and recent merger on the current mainline code carrying this path.
